title: Biased BPP from an Efficient Verifier
statement: Let $hoeal$, let $L$ be a language of bit strings, let $M$ be a Boolean verifier, and let $a,k$ be natural numbers. Suppose the verifier is polynomial-time efficient, meaning its true-output and false-output sets on encoded input-randomness pairs both lie in $P$. Suppose also that for every input $x$, the $ho$-biased weight of the length-$a(|x|+1)^k$ random strings on which $M$ outputs the indicator of membership of $x$ in $L$ is at least $2/3$. Then $L$ is decidable by a finite-state nondeterministic machine in polynomial time, with the same success threshold under $ho$-biased choices.
